Chippenham War Memorial: World War 1 and 2 memorial with 21 names for WW1 and 5 names for WW2. Located in the Churchyard of St Margaret's Church, Chippenham.
narrative: On 23 May 1944, Stirling BK784 of 90 Squadron, based at Tuddenham, came down at Chippenham, Cambridgeshire. All seven crew members aboard were killed, including the pilot, Flight Sergeant J. Whyte, alongside R. Aston, H. Eggbeer, P. Mccrory, B. Pearce, L. Sharpen, and W. Walley. Also killed in the crash was James Henry Bowden, a 24-year-old British Private, whose family were from Chippenham. The fates of two further individuals associated with the aircraft, Gerard Prideaux Tharp and Sidney Howard Jordan, remain unknown. The crash claimed at least eight lives in total.
